content.text:
Please update the branding and default states for the following tool directories to match their intended purpose. Each of these directories currently contains a clone of the "Text Viewer" tool.

### Tasks for each directory:
1. Update `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, and the `<div class="brand">` section in `index.html`.
2. Update the header comment, the `const KEY`, and the `window.addEventListener('load', ...)` block in `assets/js/main.js` to set the correct default mode (`setMode('crypto')`) and click the correct sub-tab (`.crypto-subtab[data-panel="..."]`).

### Specific branding details:

**1. Directory: encoder/**
- Title: `LxCode — Encoder / Decoder`
- Description: `Encode and decode strings with Base64, Hex, URL, HTML entities, and JWT token inspector.`
- Brand Icon: `ENC`, Style: `background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6,#a78bfa)`
- Brand Name: `Encoder / Decoder`, Sub: ` — base64 · hex · url · jwt`
- JS KEY: `lxcode_encoder`
- Default Sub-tab: `encode`

**2. Directory: encrypt/**
- Title: `LxCode — Encrypter / Decrypter`
- Description: `Symmetric encryption using AES-256-GCM via WebCrypto — passphrase-based.`
- Brand Icon: `AES`, Style: `background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d29922,#f0883e)`
- Brand Name: `Encrypter / Decrypter`, Sub: ` — secure aes-256-gcm`
- JS KEY: `lxcode_encrypt`
- Default Sub-tab: `encrypt`

**3. Directory: sign/**
- Title: `LxCode — Signer / Verifier`
- Description: `Sign messages and verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures using a shared secret key.`
- Brand Icon: `SIG`, Style: `background:linear-gradient(135deg,#059669,#10b981)`
- Brand Name: `Signer / Verifier`, Sub: ` — hmac-sha256 signing`
- JS KEY: `lxcode_sign`
- Default Sub-tab: `sign`

**4. Directory: ssl/** (Note: Logic is missing, but fix branding anyway)
- Title: `LxCode — SSL Toolkit`
- Description: `SSL checker, certificate decoder, CSR generator, key matcher, CA chain validator, and OCSP checker.`
- Brand Icon: `SSL`, Style: `background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dc2626,#ef4444)`
- Brand Name: `SSL Toolkit`, Sub: ` — certificate & CSR utilities`
- JS KEY: `lxcode_ssl`
- Default Mode: `edit` (since no SSL tab exists in the crypto panel)

Please ensure you match the existing code style exactly.
